snippet.title: Night Head - The Labyrinth (ナイトヘッド ザ・ラビリンス) - Playstation Gameplay Sample
snippet.description:
Publisher: Pony Canyon
Release Date: November 17,1995 
Genre: Adventure
Manufacturer's suggested retail price: 6,090 yen (tax included)

The Ultra-popular Drama "NIGHT HEAD" comes to PlayStation finally!! reproduced in Beautiful CG The Mikuriya Institute undisclosed is in the drama. Experience as an adventure game a side story to progress in parallel with the drama. Multiple endings that your choice will change the story.
